Plot Model Residuals

Source: R/plot_residuals.R
plot_residuals.Rd

Plots residuals from one or more fitted models.

Usage

plot_residuals(..., head = NULL, treatment = NULL, mean_treatment = FALSE)

Arguments

...

Fitted model objects.

head

Optional bottle identifier. If supplied, only the selected bottle is plotted.

treatment

Optional treatment name. If supplied, only observations belonging to the selected treatment are plotted.

mean_treatment

Logical. If TRUE, treatment means are plotted.

When used together with treatment, the function displays the mean residual profile of the selected treatment.

When treatment = NULL, mean residual profiles are displayed for all treatments.

Value

A ggplot2 object.

Details

Residuals are calculated as:

$$ Residual = Observed - Predicted $$

The function can be used to visualize:

  • A single bottle

  • All bottles within a treatment

  • Mean residual profiles for a selected treatment

  • Mean residual profiles across all treatments

  • Residual patterns from multiple fitted models

Residual plots are useful for:

  • Identifying systematic model bias

  • Detecting outliers

  • Evaluating model assumptions

  • Assessing goodness of fit

  • Comparing competing kinetic models

  • Evaluating treatment-level model performance

Ideally, residuals should be randomly distributed around zero with no obvious trend through time.

See also

plot_fit, plot_gp, plot_model_comparison, plot_dual_pools, plot_diagnostics

Examples


files <- example_data()

raw_data <- read_ankom(
  files$ankom
)

metadata <- read_metadata(
  files$metadata
)

gp <- process_ankom(
  raw_data,
  metadata,
  headspace_ml = 210,
  temperature_c = 39
)

gp_clean <- exclude_heads(
  gp,
  heads = c(
    "1",
    "2",
    "4",
    "20"
  ),
  reason = c(
    "Abnormal gas profile",
    "Abnormal gas profile",
    "Abnormal gas profile",
    "Abnormal gas profile"
  )
)

groot_fit <- fit_groot(
  gp_clean
)
#> Minor negative pressure values detected. Minimum PSI = -0.255 . These may reflect normal sensor variation.
#> rumenGP data validation passed.
#> Observations: 3038
#> Heads: 21
#> Treatments: 5

gompertz_fit <- fit_gompertz(
  gp_clean
)
#> Minor negative pressure values detected. Minimum PSI = -0.255 . These may reflect normal sensor variation.
#> rumenGP data validation passed.
#> Observations: 3038
#> Heads: 21
#> Treatments: 5

# Single bottle
plot_residuals(
  Groot = groot_fit,
  Gompertz = gompertz_fit,
  head = 6
)
#> `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'


# Treatment-specific residuals
plot_residuals(
  Groot = groot_fit,
  Gompertz = gompertz_fit,
  treatment = "TMR"
)
#> `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'


# Mean residual profile of one treatment
plot_residuals(
  Groot = groot_fit,
  Gompertz = gompertz_fit,
  treatment = "TMR",
  mean_treatment = TRUE
)
#> `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'


# Mean residual profiles of all treatments
plot_residuals(
  Groot = groot_fit,
  Gompertz = gompertz_fit,
  mean_treatment = TRUE
)
